intro: Behala & New Alipore covers the south-west of Kolkata: Behala with its old village pockets such as Barisha, Sarsuna, Sakherbazar, Parnasree Pally, Haridevpur and Joka, the planned suburb of New Alipore, and Thakurpukur further down Diamond Harbour Road. For a parent looking for a home tutor, the zone splits into two kinds of address. Much of Behala and Thakurpukur is dense, with old family houses squeezed between newer apartment buildings and builder floors on busy market streets. New Alipore is calmer and more ordered, with plot houses and apartment buildings arranged in lettered blocks, so a first visit there is usually easy to direct.

Travel here follows one road. The Purple Line runs above Diamond Harbour Road with stops at Joka, Thakurpukur, Sakherbazar, Behala Chowrasta, Behala Bazar, Taratala and Majerhat, so a tutor coming by metro is rarely more than a short auto ride from the door. The northern edge has suburban trains too, at Majerhat, Brace Bridge and New Alipore, and Majerhat connects with the Circular Railway. Tutors driving in meet the same road at its slowest in the evening peak, which is why many Behala families prefer a weekday afternoon, a weekend morning, or a tutor who already lives somewhere along the line.

On NXTutors a request from this zone is matched nearest first. Tutors who live in Behala, New Alipore or Thakurpukur are shown before those who have said they travel here, then tutors from the rest of Kolkata, and online tutors fill any gap, for example in a senior-class subject that few local tutors cover. You receive two or three matched tutors, each with their own fee visible before you book, and the first class with whichever you pick is a free demo. If that tutor stops suiting your child's timetable later in the year, switching to another costs nothing.
faqs: Which Purple Line station should a Behala family give a new tutor?

The one closest to your lane. The Purple Line has stations at Joka, Thakurpukur, Sakherbazar, Behala Chowrasta, Behala Bazar, Taratala and Majerhat along Diamond Harbour Road, and most homes are a short auto ride from one of them. Add a landmark near that station so a tutor making the first visit finds the door quickly.
Is New Alipore different from Behala for home tuition?

Yes, mainly in layout. New Alipore was planned in the 1950s and is still organised in lettered blocks of plot houses and apartment buildings, so directions are simple and most visits go straight to the door. Behala is older and denser, with houses and builder floors mixed along market streets, so a clear landmark matters more there.
Can a tutor reach New Alipore by suburban train instead of the metro?

Yes. New Alipore and Majerhat stations are both on the Budge Budge section of the suburban network, and Majerhat also meets the Circular Railway. A tutor from Tollygunge or Kalighat can instead take the Blue Line and finish by auto. Tell the tutor which station your home is nearest to when you confirm the demo.
What happens after I send a request from Thakurpukur?

You get two or three matched tutors, listed with tutors living nearest to Thakurpukur first, then those who travel to this part of Behala, then the wider city and online tutors. Each profile shows the tutor's fee before the demo, and the first class is free, so you can compare teaching styles without paying anything.

intro: This zone is the settled middle of South Kolkata: Ballygunge and the Gariahat crossing, Bhowanipore just below the Maidan, the temple lanes of Kalighat, Alipore with its bungalows and government land, and the quieter residential streets of Dhakuria, Jodhpur Park and Lake Gardens. Homes are overwhelmingly long-lived-in family addresses rather than new towers. Old houses, some shared by several generations, stand beside small apartment buildings, and Jodhpur Park's regular plotted streets are among the easiest in the city for a new tutor to find. In Alipore, larger homes and apartment buildings more often have a staffed gate, which changes how the first visit is arranged.

Few parts of Kolkata offer a tutor as many ways in. Rabindra Sadan, Netaji Bhavan, Jatin Das Park, Kalighat and Rabindra Sarobar on the Blue Line cover the western half; Ballygunge Junction, Dhakuria and Lake Gardens on the suburban lines serve the east and south; and the Orange Line stations at Kavi Sukanta and Hemanta Mukhopadhyay sit across the railway on the bypass side. That wide reach means families here can often choose between several nearby tutors. The pinch points are the Gariahat crossing on weekend evenings, office-hour roads through Bhowanipore, and Diamond Harbour Road near Alipore in the evening peak.

When you ask NXTutors for a tutor in Ballygunge, Lake Gardens or any other part of the zone, the list starts with tutors based here, moves to those who say they travel here, and then widens to Kolkata as a whole and to online tutors. That order matters most for older students with long days, because a nearby tutor can take a later slot without a tiring journey. You see two or three matched tutors, each tutor's own fee before anything is booked, and a free first demo. Changing tutor afterwards is free as well, so an early choice is never locked in.
faqs: Which metro stations reach Bhowanipore and Kalighat homes?

The Blue Line serves both. Rabindra Sadan, Netaji Bhavan and Jatin Das Park cover Bhowanipore, and Kalighat station serves the temple area, so most tutors walk or take a rickshaw for the last stretch. Streets near the temple are crowded on festival days and weekends, so a weekday evening lesson is usually easier to keep.
Do Jodhpur Park and Lake Gardens suit weekday evening lessons at home?

Usually, yes. Both are mainly residential, with independent houses and small apartment buildings where the tutor goes straight to the door. Rabindra Sarobar on the Blue Line and the Dhakuria and Lake Gardens suburban stations are close by. Roads near the lake fill in the evening peak, so leave a little margin either side.
What should an Alipore family tell a tutor before the first visit?

How the gate works. Many larger homes and apartment buildings in Alipore have a staffed gate, so share the tutor's name and arrival time in advance. Tutors usually come via Kalighat or Jatin Das Park on the Blue Line, or Majerhat and Kidderpore on the Circular section, and an earlier slot avoids the evening rush.
Can my child have some lessons at home and some online?

Yes. The request lets you choose home, online or a mix, and many families combine them. A common pattern is home lessons for core subjects with a nearby tutor and online sessions for a specialist subject taught from elsewhere in the city. Either way the shortlist has two or three matched tutors, and the first demo is free.

intro: Tollygunge, Jadavpur & Garia follows the Adi Ganga south from the film studios of Tollygunge through Golf Green, Regent Park, Jadavpur, Bansdroni, Naktala and Baghajatin to Garia at the city's southern edge. Much of it grew after independence as families from East Bengal built homes on what had been farmland and marsh, and that history shows in the housing: family houses along side lanes, compact apartment buildings on the main roads, and low-rise flats set among open grounds in Golf Green. Garia adds newer residential buildings, builder floors and plots, with part of the locality under a separate municipality.

The Blue Line is the zone's spine, with Mahanayak Uttam Kumar, Netaji, Masterda Surya Sen, Gitanjali, Kavi Nazrul and Shahid Khudiram along the way, and the Orange Line meets the southern end at Kavi Subhash. Jadavpur, Baghajatin and Garia add suburban trains, and Tollygunge has a Budge Budge line station. A tutor on the metro therefore reaches most doors with only an auto or rickshaw ride. What slows a lesson is road traffic: the 8B crossing at college and office hours and the main road to Garia in the evening peak.

Because the metro links almost every locality here, a family in Naktala might be matched with a tutor from Tollygunge as easily as with one from the next lane. NXTutors still orders the list by distance: tutors living in the zone first, then those who travel in, then others in Kolkata, then online tutors for subjects or boards where the local pool is thin. Two or three matched tutors come back, you see what each charges before choosing, and try the first class as a free demo. If the match stops working in a later term, switching tutor is free.
faqs: Which station should a Garia family give a visiting tutor?

The one nearest your home. Garia is served by Blue Line stations at its southern end such as Kavi Nazrul and Shahid Khudiram, by the Orange Line at Kavi Subhash, and by the Garia suburban stations. Share that station and a landmark when you book, so a tutor on the first visit finds the door easily.
When is the 8B crossing in Jadavpur hard to get through?

At college and office hours, when the commercial hub around the bus terminus is at its busiest. Weekend mornings or early afternoons are easier for a tutor who has to cross it. Families in Bijoygarh or Sulekha can also ask for a tutor who already lives on the same side of the crossing.
Are homes in Bansdroni and Naktala easy for a tutor to reach?

Mostly, yes. Both are largely residential, with houses and small or mid-sized apartment buildings where the tutor usually goes straight to the door. Masterda Surya Sen serves Bansdroni and Gitanjali serves Naktala on the Blue Line. The main road between Tollygunge and Garia is slow in the evening peak, so plan around it.
Can we switch if the first tutor does not suit our child?

Yes, and it costs nothing. The first class with any matched tutor is a free demo, and if the fit is wrong another tutor from your shortlist can take over. Later on, switching tutor is also free, which helps when a new timetable in Class 10 or Class 12 changes your free evenings.

intro: Kasba & EM Bypass South takes in Kasba, Santoshpur, Mukundapur and Patuli, the neighbourhoods strung along the southern stretch of the Eastern Metropolitan Bypass. It is a zone of two generations of housing. The inner paras of Kasba and Santoshpur keep family houses and small buildings from the decades when the area was first settled, while the land closer to the bypass, especially in Mukundapur, is filled with newer apartment projects behind a gate. Patuli is different again: a planned township of blocks with serviced plots for family houses, group-housing apartments and land set aside for markets.

For a visiting tutor, the Orange Line has changed this zone. Stations along the bypass at Satyajit Ray, Jyotirindra Nandi, Kavi Sukanta, Hemanta Mukhopadhyay and VIP Bazar mean a tutor from Garia or Beleghata can now arrive by metro, and Kavi Subhash sits at the southern end near Patuli. On the rail side, Ballygunge Junction, Jadavpur and Baghajatin serve the western edge. The bypass junctions and the Kasba connector are at their worst in the evening rush, so families near the bypass often book afternoon or weekend lessons, or pick a tutor who travels by metro.

Parents here often weigh a complex's gate rules against the convenience of a lesson at home. NXTutors helps by listing tutors who live in Kasba, Santoshpur, Mukundapur or Patuli first, then tutors who travel to the bypass side, then those from elsewhere in Kolkata, and finally online tutors, who suit specialist subjects when no one nearby can take them. Your request brings two or three matched tutors, each showing their own fee before you book, and the first class with your choice is a free demo. If the arrangement stops working, you can switch tutor at no charge.
faqs: Which Orange Line stations serve Mukundapur and Santoshpur?

Jyotirindra Nandi at Mukundapur and Satyajit Ray at Panchasayar are the closest, with Kavi Sukanta at Kalikapur further north. Santoshpur also has Jadavpur and Baghajatin on the suburban lines. A tutor using any of these usually finishes the trip by auto, so share the nearest station and a landmark when you book.
What address details help a tutor find a home in Patuli?

The block and plot number. Patuli was built as a planned township divided into blocks on both sides of the bypass connector, so those two details locate almost any plot house. For a group-housing apartment, also give the flat number and send the tutor's name to the gate before the demo class.
Do gated complexes near the bypass make home tuition harder?

Only slightly, if you plan ahead. Complexes in Mukundapur and near the Kasba connector usually register visitors, so send the tutor's name and lesson time to the gate before the demo and ask for a standing entry for regular classes. In the inner paras of Kasba and Santoshpur, the tutor usually goes straight to the door.
Does NXTutors show tutors from Kasba itself first?

Yes. The list starts with tutors who live in the zone, then adds tutors who have said they travel to Kasba and the bypass side, then others from Kolkata, then online tutors. You receive two or three matched tutors with their fees shown upfront, and the first class with whichever tutor you choose is free.

intro: Salt Lake, or Bidhannagar, is one of the most orderly places in Kolkata to arrange a home tutor. Sectors I, II and III, the residential heart of the township, were laid out on reclaimed wetland in lettered blocks such as AA, AB, BL, DL, FD and IB, divided by numbered avenues and cross roads. Most families live in independent houses on plots, with a smaller number of apartment buildings mixed in, and Sector I is the oldest part. Sector V, the office and IT district, sits beside the residential sectors, which is why the roads leading towards it behave so differently from the quiet inner streets.

The Green Line runs through the township, with City Centre and Central Park in Sector I, Karunamoyee beside the bus terminal in Sector II, and Bengal Chemical and Salt Lake Stadium on the bypass side of Sector III. Now that it runs on to Sealdah, Esplanade and Howrah Maidan, tutors from central Kolkata and across the river can reach Salt Lake without a car. Bidhannagar Road station serves the western edge, and the bridge to Kestopur links VIP Road. Office-hour traffic heads for Sector V and the bypass, so lessons after the evening rush or at weekends are easier to keep.

Most Salt Lake homes open straight onto the street, so the first class is usually as simple as a tutor ringing the bell. On NXTutors, the tutors offered for a Salt Lake request start with those in the township, then tutors who travel here from Lake Town, Dum Dum or New Town, then the rest of Kolkata, then online tutors, which is useful when a specialist subject needs someone further away. Two or three matched tutors are suggested, each fee is on show before you book, the first class is a free demo, and switching later is free.
faqs: Which Green Line station is closest to my Salt Lake block?

It depends on the sector. City Centre and Central Park stand inside Sector I, Karunamoyee serves much of Sector II, and Salt Lake Stadium or Bengal Chemical on the bypass suit Sector III, where Karunamoyee is also close. Tell the tutor your station, block letter and house number when you book the demo.
Why do tutors ask for the block letter, not just the house number?

Because the township is organised by block. Every Salt Lake address combines a block code such as AB, DL or FE with a house number, laid out along numbered avenues and cross roads, and tutors navigate by those. Adding the nearest avenue or Green Line station makes the first visit straightforward.
Is Sector V traffic a problem for evening tuition in Salt Lake?

It can be at office hours. Roads towards Sector V and the EM Bypass fill as people leave work, while the inner residential streets stay quiet. Choose a slot after the evening rush, a weekend lesson, or a tutor who comes by Green Line, and the timing problem mostly disappears.
What does a home tutor in Salt Lake usually cost?

Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. Tutors set their own fees, and each one's fee appears on the profile before the free demo.

intro: New Town & Rajarhat covers the planned township of New Town, in its Action Areas I, II and III, and the older Rajarhat belt around it, including Chinar Park and Teghoria. Almost every family here lives in an apartment complex. Action Area I mixes plotted blocks with government housing and private towers; around Eco Park, Action Area II is almost entirely complexes; and Action Area III, the third phase, is a mid-segment spread of two- and three-bed apartments and several sub-townships. Chinar Park has many ready flats, while on Rajarhat's side roads some families still live in houses with their own front door.

This is the one zone in greater Kolkata where the metro has not arrived yet. Orange Line stations for New Town, among them Nazrul Tirtha and Eco Park, are still under construction, and so is the VIP Road station. For now tutors arrive by bus, app cab or two-wheeler along Biswa Bangla Sarani, Rajarhat Main Road or VIP Road, many of them changing at Salt Lake Sector V, where the Green Line ends. Wide roads make driving simple, but the Chinar Park crossing and the Teghoria junction are heavy at office hours, and visitor parking inside complexes varies from one to the next.

With travel harder than elsewhere, the order NXTutors uses matters. A request from New Town or Rajarhat first shows tutors who live in the zone, then those who have said they travel here, often from Baguiati or Salt Lake, after that tutors elsewhere in Kolkata, with online tutors last, a practical answer for subjects with few local teachers. The shortlist holds two or three matched tutors, and each one's fee is visible before booking. The first class is a free demo, and you can move to a different tutor later without paying anything extra for the change.
faqs: Is there a metro to New Town for a visiting tutor yet?

Not yet. Nazrul Tirtha, planned for Action Area 1A, and Eco Park, being built in the middle of Biswa Bangla Sarani in Action Area IIE, are Orange Line stations still under construction. Until they open, a tutor travelling by metro usually gets off at Salt Lake Sector V and covers the rest by auto, bus or cab.
What should I send the security desk before a tutor's first visit?

The tutor's name, phone number and lesson time, along with your tower and flat number. Almost every home in New Town sits inside a gated complex that registers visitors, so doing this before the demo avoids a wait at the gate. For weekly classes, ask whether a standing entry is possible.
Which Action Area is hardest for a home tutor to reach?

Action Area III. It has no open metro station close by, so a visiting tutor relies on buses along New Town Road, an app cab or a two-wheeler. Someone based within the township or in neighbouring Rajarhat usually keeps weekly timings most reliably, and online classes can cover a subject no local tutor takes on.
Will NXTutors suggest online tutors for a New Town request?

Yes, when they help. Tutors living in the zone come first, then those who travel here, then others in Kolkata; online tutors fill gaps, such as a senior-class subject with no local match. The shortlist is still two or three matched tutors, with fees shown upfront and a free first demo.

intro: Lake Town, Dum Dum & Baguiati runs along VIP Road and Jessore Road on the north-eastern side of Kolkata. It includes planned Lake Town with its parks and lake, Bangur Avenue between the two main roads, Kestopur beside Salt Lake, busy Baguiati with sub-localities such as Jyangra, Raghunathpur and Arjunpur, and the large Dum Dum area with Nagerbazar, Gora Bazar and Dum Dum Cantonment. Housing is mostly flats in low- and mid-rise buildings and builder floors, with independent houses still common and only some gated complexes, so many tutors knock on a flat door rather than sign in at a gate.

Transport is uneven across the zone. Dum Dum is one of the most connected places in the city, with the Blue Line, Dum Dum Junction on the Sealdah to Ranaghat line, Dum Dum Cantonment on the Bangaon line, and the Yellow Line running towards the airport. Lake Town and Bangur Avenue use Bidhannagar Road, Patipukur and the Blue Line at Belgachia or Dum Dum. Baguiati has no metro station yet, so tutors take a bus or an auto along VIP Road. Both main roads carry airport traffic, so building some slack around the evening peak into the lesson time pays off.

For families in Dum Dum, a wide choice of tutors can come by train; in Baguiati and Kestopur the shortlist leans more on tutors who already live close by. NXTutors handles both the same way. It lists tutors living in the zone, then tutors who travel here, then others from Kolkata, and then online tutors for anything the local pool cannot cover. Every request brings two or three matched tutors, with each fee shown before you choose, and the first class is a free demo. Changing tutor at any later point is free.
faqs: Why is it easier to find a home tutor in Dum Dum than in Baguiati?

Because of rail links. Dum Dum has the Blue Line, the Yellow Line, Dum Dum Junction and Dum Dum Cantonment, so tutors from much of north and central Kolkata can arrive by train. Baguiati has no metro station yet, so tutors come by bus or auto along VIP Road, which narrows the pool.
How should a Baguiati or Kestopur family give directions to a new tutor?

Share an exact landmark off VIP Road. Baguiati addresses are spread across sub-localities such as Jyangra, Raghunathpur and Arjunpur, and Kestopur runs along Kestopur Main Road and Canal Side Road. Naming the road, the nearest bus stop and your building saves the tutor time on the first visit.
Does the Yellow Line help tutors reach this zone?

Yes, on the Dum Dum side. Since August 2025 the Yellow Line has run from Noapara through Dum Dum Cantonment and along Jessore Road to the airport station, adding another rail route for tutors. Its Birati section is still under construction, so check the stop nearest your home before relying on it.
Do I pay anything before the demo class?

No. The first class with the tutor you choose is a free demo, and you see that tutor's fee on the profile before booking it. If the demo goes well you agree a schedule; if not, another matched tutor can try. Switching tutor later is also free, whatever the reason.

intro: North Kolkata, as NXTutors groups it, covers Shyambazar, Bagbazar, Sovabazar, Maniktala, Belgachia and Sinthee, the old riverside and market neighbourhoods north of the centre. Housing here is the oldest on the city's tutor map: family houses with verandahs and latticework along narrow lanes, heritage mansions in Sovabazar, and plots that have been rebuilt as small apartment buildings. Maniktala and Belgachia add more flats in mid-size buildings, and Sinthee is mostly apartments near Barrackpore Trunk Road. For a tutor, nearly every visit is to a street-level door rather than a gated complex, which keeps the first class simple.

Public transport is the sensible way in. The Blue Line stops at Belgachia, Shyambazar, Sovabazar Sutanuti and Girish Park, and further north at Dum Dum for Sinthee; the Circular Railway serves Bagbazar and Sovabazar Ahiritola; Sealdah on the Green Line suits Maniktala; and ferries reach Bagbazar Ghat. A car often struggles with the last lanes, so most tutors walk or take a rickshaw from the station. School and office hours crowd the Shyambazar five-point crossing and the market roads, and Puja season fills the heritage lanes, so mid-afternoon or later evening lessons are usually easier.

Families in these neighbourhoods are often matched with tutors who live a station or two away along the Blue Line. NXTutors puts tutors from the zone itself first, then tutors who have said they travel to North Kolkata, then the rest of the city, then online tutors, who help for advanced or specialist subjects. One request brings two or three matched tutors, with each tutor's fee visible before you decide, and a free demo as the first class. If circumstances change later, for example in the months before board exams, switching tutor costs nothing.
faqs: Should a tutor drive or use the metro in Shyambazar and Sovabazar?

The metro, in most cases. Shyambazar and Sovabazar Sutanuti are on the Blue Line, and the last stretch is usually on foot or by rickshaw through narrow lanes where parking is hard. Buses along the old Chitpur Road are another option. A car mainly adds time around the five-point crossing.
How does Durga Puja affect lessons in North Kolkata?

The heritage lanes of Sovabazar and Bagbazar fill with visitors during Puja, and the family mansions there have held celebrations since 1757. For those weeks, move lessons earlier in the day or switch to online sessions for a while, then return to home lessons once the lanes clear.
Which stations help tutors reach Maniktala, Belgachia and Sinthee?

Girish Park on the Blue Line and Sealdah on the Green Line serve Maniktala. Belgachia has its own Blue Line station, open since 1984. For Sinthee, Dum Dum metro and Dum Dum Junction are nearest, with an auto from there or from Sinthee More on Barrackpore Trunk Road to the door.
Can I compare tutors before paying for North Kolkata lessons?

Yes. NXTutors suggests two or three matched tutors, with those living nearest you listed first, and every profile shows the tutor's fee before you book. The first class with your chosen tutor is a free demo, so you compare actual teaching, not just profiles, before committing to regular lessons.

intro: Howrah covers Shibpur, Salkia and Santragachi, across the Hooghly from central Kolkata. The three localities feel quite different to a tutor. Shibpur has a densely built old core of houses along narrow lanes, with multi-storey complexes on newer land. Salkia in north Howrah has flats in medium-sized buildings and older independent houses around busy market streets. Santragachi, along the Kona Expressway, is largely made up of gated complexes of two- and three-bed flats, so gate registration is routine there and almost absent in the old lanes of Salkia. For the first class, that difference decides whether you send the guard a name or simply give the tutor a lane landmark.

Crossing the river used to be the main obstacle for tutors from Kolkata. Today the Green Line tunnels beneath the river, stops at Howrah and Howrah Maidan, and carries on without a break through Sealdah to Salt Lake, so a tutor from the east side can arrive by metro and complete the trip by auto or rickshaw. Santragachi Junction and the South Eastern suburban trains serve Howrah's western side, Liluah and Tikiapara serve Salkia, Shalimar is near Shibpur, and ferries cross from ghats along the river. The Kona Expressway and Grand Trunk Road slow down at office hours, so leave some margin around a weekday evening lesson.

Even with the metro, a tutor who already works on the Howrah side is often the most reliable choice for weekly visits. NXTutors reflects that: tutors living in Howrah come first, then tutors who have said they travel here, then those from across Kolkata, then online tutors when a subject has no nearby match. You receive two or three matched tutors, can read each one's fee before booking, and start with a free demo class. If a tutor stops fitting your routine, perhaps after a change of school hours, you can switch to another at no cost.
faqs: Can a Kolkata-based tutor reach Shibpur or Salkia by metro?

Yes. Since the Green Line began running beneath the river, a tutor from Sealdah, Esplanade or Salt Lake can ride to Howrah or Howrah Maidan and take an auto or bus onward to Salkia or Shibpur. Tutors living near the river on the Kolkata side can also cross by ferry to the Howrah ghats.
What do Santragachi complexes need before a tutor's first visit?

A heads-up at the gate. Most homes there are in complexes where guards record every visitor, so pass on the tutor's name, your tower, flat and any entry rules before the demo. A tutor from elsewhere in Howrah may arrive by local train at Santragachi Junction; one from Kolkata usually comes over the Kona Expressway.
Why do directions matter so much in Salkia and the older part of Shibpur?

Because the older parts are densely built, with houses along narrow lanes off the main roads, and market streets such as those around Salkia's bazaar, more than a century old, get crowded in the evening. A clear lane landmark lets a first-time tutor find the door on foot or by rickshaw without losing lesson time.
Does NXTutors prefer Howrah-side tutors for a Howrah request?

It lists them first. Tutors who live in Howrah appear before tutors who travel over from Kolkata, followed by the wider city and then online tutors. Your shortlist holds two or three matched tutors with their fees on show, and the first class is a free demo before you decide on regular lessons.
